intro: Write down your questions before the visit. Bring this list. You do not have to remember everything.

groups.title: Describing what is happening
questions: When did it start, and what makes it better or worse?
Where do I feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
Do I also have sweating, shortness of breath, nausea or dizziness?

groups.title: Your history and medicines
questions: Which of my past heart problems or procedures should I mention?
Which of my medicines matter for this?
Does anyone in my family have heart disease?

groups.title: Tests and next steps
questions: What do you think could be causing this, and what tests do I need?
Where will I go for the tests, and who takes me?
Can my family member come with me?
Is it okay to drive, exercise or work for now?

groups.title: Safety
questions: What should I do if the pain comes back or gets worse?
Who do I call, and what number do I use at night?
